# Fixtures

Every file here is **synthetic**, written by hand from knowledge of the API's
key names and types. None is derived from, or transformed from, real traffic.
`tests/test_fixtures_synthetic.py` enforces this (synthetic UUID prefix,
`@example.com` emails, Times Square coordinates, `test-` tokens, `example.com`
URLs). Never paste raw captures here.

Fixed values: clock `2026-01-15T18:00:00Z`; diner `…0001`; orders `…00a1`
(active), `…00a2` (old), `…00a3` (delivered).
